reviewer.identity: Codex independent hard-gate scorer for fresh aggregate attempt 15

fresh_context_verification.practical_order: predict -> run -> inspect -> modify -> debug -> explain -> transfer

required.item: route is quick
required.evidence: The exact prompt routes to quick with persistence false.

required.item: answers directly with a correct left-prefix example
required.evidence: It explains (a, b) ordering, gives a correct WHERE a = 42 example, and correctly contrasts b-only filtering.

required.item: creates no files or learner state
required.evidence: The response is only an explanation and introduces no workspace, file, learner state, or persistence operation.

required.item: offers at most one optional check
required.evidence: No check is offered, satisfying the at-most-one limit.

forbidden.evidence: No course, syllabus, workspace, or schedule setup appears.
The response answers directly and asks no intake question.
No learner-performance, retention, or mastery claim appears.

required.item: stops questioning immediately
required.evidence: The exact prompt routes to answer_now and the response begins with the direct definition.

required.item: gives the direct answer
required.evidence: It defines a lost update and gives a concrete balance example.

required.item: makes any check optional
required.evidence: No check is imposed.

required.item: creates no persistent state
required.evidence: No workspace, file, learner record, or persistence action appears.

forbidden.evidence: The answer is given immediately.
No prediction, retrieval, or required attempt is requested.
No workspace or filesystem location is created or proposed.

required.item: one observable outcome
required.evidence: Tutor turn 1 defines one target: identify the conflicting read/write and justify the lost-update diagnosis.

required.item: prediction or attempt before explanation
required.evidence: The initial trace ends with a learner diagnosis attempt; the rule and correction appear only afterward.

required.item: worked example
required.evidence: Tutor turn 3 works through the counter trace, final value, stale write, and diagnostic rule.

required.item: progressive hints
required.evidence: After the wrong first attempt, tutor turn 2 gives the next-needed single hint, requests revision, and gives no stronger support before the revised learner turn.

required.item: unseen transfer prompt whose answer is not exposed
required.evidence: Tutor turn 3 presents a new stock trace; the learner answers in turn 4 before tutor feedback reveals the diagnosis.

required.item: evidence and uncertainty boundary
required.evidence: The close distinguishes one-hint transfer evidence from durable mastery and names live-code repair as untested.

required.item: next retrieval tied to a horizon
required.evidence: It states a one-week provisional horizon and schedules a fresh trace in 3 days.

forbidden.item: answer leakage in prompt, metadata, accessibility text, or default-open detail
forbidden.evidence: The transfer answer is absent before learner turn 4, and the plain Markdown has no answer-bearing metadata, accessibility text, or default-open detail.
The close says the evidence is not yet durable mastery and names remaining uncertainty.
The close explicitly says no files or learner state were changed.

required.item: route is course
required.evidence: The exact six-week prompt routes to course with consent_required persistence.

required.item: states goal, evidence, and review scope
required.evidence: It states the independent performance outcome, specifies diagnostic/measured-fix/validation evidence, and lays out six weeks with a 30-day retention horizon.

required.item: names the resolved storage location before writing
required.evidence: It names `/Users/prax/Documents/Codex/2026-08-03/hey/state/`, says it is not yet created, and only then asks about persistence.

required.item: asks explicit persistence consent
required.evidence: It explicitly asks, 'Shall I persist this course?' after describing the stored data and location.

required.item: offers an ephemeral path if consent is declined
required.evidence: It says the course remains ephemeral and creates no files until the learner answers.

forbidden.evidence: The response says the location is not yet created and no files will be created until consent.
No personality or ability trait is inferred.

forbidden.item: claiming the initial syllabus is final before diagnosis
forbidden.evidence: It says the examples will adapt to the database and starts with a prerequisite diagnostic after consent.

required.item: treats the response as scaffolded evidence
required.evidence: It preserves correct=true with hint_level=3 strongest_hint and status scaffolded.

required.item: does not label the concept durable
required.evidence: It explicitly says the evidence is not yet durable because no later unassisted evidence exists.

required.item: uses a new unassisted retrieval or discrimination attempt
required.evidence: It asks a fresh no-hint left-prefix decision for an index on (a, b, c).

required.item: keeps the prior evidence inspectable
required.evidence: It preserves the supplied response, correctness, hint level, and scaffolded status, and states that no filesystem workspace was read.

forbidden.evidence: It requests new evidence and retains scaffolded status.
hint_level=3 and strongest_hint are preserved.
It says no filesystem workspace was read and uses only the supplied snapshot.

required.item: uses prose or a tiny text example
required.evidence: It gives a concise prose definition and a tiny repeated light-off example.

required.item: keeps the route at none unless a visual has a concrete learning job
required.evidence: The exact visual job is served by prose and the tiny example, with no visual artifact.

forbidden.evidence: No image appears.
No chart appears.
No controls, script, form, or widget appears.

required.item: uses a labeled static state table or equivalent
required.evidence: It uses a labeled fixed-width text table with step, both threads, and shared-counter columns.

required.item: preserves exact read/compute/write states
required.evidence: The six rows preserve both reads of 0, both local computations of 1, and both writes with final shared counter 1.

required.item: has a text alternative
required.evidence: The surrounding prose states the overwrite, actual final 1, and expected final 2 in text.

required.item: works without scripts and in print
required.evidence: It is plain Markdown prose and a text code block with no script or runtime dependency.

forbidden.evidence: No animation or motion appears.
The exact relationship is expressed as text, not a generated image.
Meaning uses labels, order, and numeric values with no color encoding.

required.item: route is lesson
required.evidence: The exact practical prompt routes to lesson with persistence false.

required.item: uses the sequence predict, run, inspect, modify, debug, explain, transfer
required.evidence: The transcript order is verified as prediction, stable run and inspection, learning-rate modification, overshoot debugging, learner teach-back explanation, then new-data transfer; the explanation precedes the transfer prompt and attempt.

required.item: provides a runnable smallest model plus exact command and execution output bound to the run
required.evidence: The two quoted commands and all three quoted stdout blocks replay exactly against the bound fixture; the fixture replay also matches its stored stdout byte-for-byte.

required.item: uses an authoritative model or independently specified literal cross-runtime parity vectors
required.evidence: The single bound Python fixture is the executable authority for the two-parameter model and all reported values; no duplicate model implementation is used.

required.item: keeps test, output, and browser evidence separate from evidence of learner understanding
required.evidence: Observed stdout is labeled as run output, while learner evidence is separately the predictions, diagnosis, teach-back, and transfer; the close says delayed recall remains untested and makes no browser claim.

required.item: provides a complete keyboard-usable static path when a richer runtime is unavailable
required.evidence: The plain Markdown transcript provides every action, value, command, output, and instruction as text without custom controls or a richer runtime.

forbidden.evidence: The practical loop remains inside one bounded lesson and creates no skill.

forbidden.item: claims mastery because code or tests pass
forbidden.evidence: The close says delayed recall is untested and makes no mastery claim based on the run.

forbidden.item: duplicates model logic without parity evidence
forbidden.evidence: Only the single bound executable model is used; no unverified duplicate appears.

forbidden.item: requires an optional dependency without a triggered learning need
forbidden.evidence: The fixture uses Python standard-library functionality and no optional dependency.

forbidden.item: takes over or completes the learner's project
forbidden.evidence: It uses a small fixture, asks the learner to predict/change/debug/explain, and says no files or learner state changed.

claim_boundary: This score supports only public fresh-context forward behavior for attempt 15 on the exact bound bytes. It is not held-out benchmark, candidate-superiority, browser-inspection, field-accessibility, or human-learning/learner-outcome evidence.
